name: 19520 · Elverson, PA
findings: ZIP 19520 (Elverson) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19520 (Elverson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19520 (Elverson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
